profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Oracle GBU
profile.summary: Software Engineer experienced with Microservices, Domain Driven Design, and Full-Stack development.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with microservices, CQRS, message publishing using .Net Core.
- Integrated software with third party vendors with our software with varying technologies from REST to SOAP using .Net Core, Cosmos AB, and SQL.
- Had ownership over two React projects where I lead the requirements gathering and development efforts for the team.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered solutions to business problems across several departments by developing applications.
Utilized Agile and SCRUM methodologies to help manage all parts of the software development life cycle.
Lead a project consisting of a mobile application using React Native and .NET, and orchestrated deployments and versions to allow backwards compatibility.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description: Working directly with customers making sure they were satisfied with their purchases. Working as a cashier handling money, and transactions. Working as a team with the rest of the associate to meet sales goals.

positions.title: Desktop Support Technician
positions.description: Diagnose and fix computer hardware and software issues. Be proficient with ServiceNow PAAS software.
